name: Exp_VortexIndicator_MMRec_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on the Vortex Indicator, which measures trend direction by comparing VM+ and VM- lines to detect positive and negative trend momentum. It uses a money management recommendation system with duplex (dual-direction) logic, allowing both long and short entries when the Vortex lines cross. Position sizing and risk are managed through configurable money management parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于涡旋指标（Vortex Indicator）进行交易，通过比较VM+和VM-线的交叉来检测正向和负向趋势动量。它采用资金管理推荐系统和双向（Duplex）交易逻辑，允许在涡旋线交叉时同时做多和做空。仓位规模和风险通过可配置的资金管理参数进行控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于涡旋指标（Vortex Indicator），该指标由Etienne Botes和Douglas Siepman开发，通过计算正向趋势运动（VM+）和负向趋势运动（VM-）来识别趋势方向。入场条件为VM+线上穿VM-线时做多，VM-线上穿VM+线时做空，这是典型的动量交叉策略。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或预设的止损止盈水平。仓位管理采用资金管理推荐（MMRec）系统，根据账户余额和风险比例动态调整交易手数。双向（Duplex）逻辑意味着EA可以同时管理多头和空头头寸，不会因为一个方向持仓而阻止反方向信号入场。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，在趋势明确启动时入场，适合趋势明显的中长期行情。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Vortex Indicator, developed by Etienne Botes and Douglas Siepman, which identifies trend direction by calculating positive trend movement (VM+) and negative trend movement (VM-). Entry conditions trigger a buy when VM+ crosses above VM- and a sell when VM- crosses above VM+, representing a classic momentum crossover strategy. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing employs a Money Management Recommendation (MMRec) system that dynamically adjusts lot sizes based on account balance and risk ratios. The Duplex logic means the EA can simultaneously manage both long and short positions without blocking opposite-direction signals when one direction is already held. Overall, the strategy falls into the momentum-following category, entering when a trend is clearly initiating, and is suited for medium-to-long-term markets with well-defined trends.

parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for dynamic lot sizing

pros: 涡旋指标对趋势启动敏感度高，能较早捕捉趋势转折点
双向（Duplex）模式允许同时持有多空仓位，在震荡行情中可能减少错过机会的概率
资金管理推荐系统提供动态仓位调整，有助于根据账户规模合理控制风险
pros_en: The Vortex Indicator is highly sensitive to trend initiation, capturing trend reversals early
Duplex mode allows simultaneous long and short positions, potentially reducing missed opportunities during choppy markets
The Money Management Recommendation system provides dynamic position sizing to help control risk proportionally to account size
cons: 动量交叉类指标在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
双向持仓模式在强趋势行情中可能造成一边持仓持续亏损而对冲效果有限
止损和止盈默认为0，如果不手动设置则缺乏风险退出机制，存在较大资金回撤风险
cons_en: Momentum crossover indicators tend to generate frequent false signals during ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Duplex holding mode may cause sustained losses on one side during strong trends with limited hedging effectiveness
Default stop-loss and take-profit values are 0, meaning without manual configuration there is no risk exit mechanism, posing significant drawdown risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期MA）以在震荡行情中减少虚假交叉信号
设置非零默认止损止盈值，并增加追踪止损功能以保护浮盈
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or large-period MA) to reduce false crossover signals during ranging markets
Set non-zero default stop-loss and take-profit values, and add a trailing stop feature to protect floating profits

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，若用户未手动设置则交易无退出保护
双向持仓在极端单边行情中可能同时承受多空双方的资金压力
涡旋指标交叉信号在窄幅震荡中频繁触发，可能导致过度交易
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, meaning trades have no exit protection if users do not manually configure them
Dual-direction holding may expose the account to margin pressure from both sides during extreme one-way markets
Vortex crossover signals trigger frequently in narrow ranges, potentially leading to overtrading

It uses a money management recommendation system with duplex (dual-direction) logic, allowing both long and short entries when the Vortex lines cross. Position sizing and risk are managed through configurable money management parameters.
